newsitem.title: BELGIUM: TER BEKE KEEPS 1996 DIVIDEND UNCHANGED.
newsitem.headline: TER BEKE KEEPS 1996 DIVIDEND UNCHANGED.

text.p: Belgian packaged meats and meals producer Ter Beke NV said on Thursday it would keep its 1996 net dividend per share unchanged at 40 francs despite the fall group net profit to 25.5 million francs from 147.7 million.
The company said in a statement to the shareholders meeting on it was keeping the dividend unchanged "to give a sign of confidence in the future".
But it added that the latest pork price increases could only be partly charged through to customers which was making it very hard to return to the profit level of 1995.
